title: Traceable Searchable ADR Memory Index
one_liner: A framework for traceable, searchable project memory with multi-agent sprint automation and architecture decision tracking.
what_it_is: A CLI framework installed into existing projects to provide structured session tracking, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and parallel AI agent sprints using git worktrees. It separates framework logic from project data, ensuring all sprint briefs, sessions, and decisions are committed to the project repo for full git history traceability.
how_its_built: The framework consists of Bash scripts for sprint orchestration (init, run, merge, validate) and a Python/HTML dashboard for visualization. It includes an optional TypeScript-based 'Afterburner' agent engine that manages context, skills, and tool execution for autonomous coding agents. Setup is handled via a shell script that scaffolds the target project with necessary directories and configuration files.
how_to_apply: Run the setup script against your target project directory to install sprint scripts and templates. Configure test commands and ephemeral files in the generated config. Use the provided scripts to manage sprint lifecycles, or integrate the TypeScript agent engine for automated task execution within isolated git worktrees.
features: Automates parallel AI agent sprints using isolated git worktrees
Enforces structured Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and session logs
Provides a web dashboard for tracking sprint lifecycle and pipeline status
Ensures full traceability by committing all memory artifacts to project git history
Includes validation and auto-fix scripts for sprint brief formatting
Supports multi-agent coordination via tmux sessions and shared context
